verification.title: How we verify practitioners
verification.intro: Patients should be able to trust who they find here. This page explains, plainly, what "Verified" means on AltCare.
verification.s1Body: An AltCare administrator has reviewed the documents the practitioner submitted. We check that the practitioner is registered with the relevant board or council for their discipline, and that the degree certificates they list match. The administrator then records a decision and a short note.
verification.s2Body: Verification is a manual review of documents. Nothing is automated, and we do not judge the quality of anyone's treatment. A verified badge is not a guarantee of results or a medical endorsement.
verification.s3Body: A practitioner cannot be listed without being verified, and verification costs nothing.
verification.s4Body: Being listed is a plan feature. Practitioners on a paid plan are not shown as better or more trusted than others. The Verified badge means the same for everyone.
verification.s5Body: We do not show star ratings or patient reviews. They are easy to manipulate and say little about treatment.
verification.s6Body: If a profile looks wrong, or you have a concern about a practitioner, tell us and we will look into it.
